version.changelog:
Major update: Skill now provides detailed assistant capabilities and comprehensive information for Caocao mobility services.

- Updated name to "曹操出行" and version to 1.0.0
- Expanded description to highlight expertise in EV mobility, trip planning, cost comparison, and corporate rides
- Added detailed platform features, service types, fare estimation, safety functions, and corporate solutions
- Replaced placeholder/coming soon content with actionable guidance and comparisons to other ride-hailing platforms
- Included up-to-date service cities, usage tips, and user guidance

llm.summary: This is a text-only Caocao ride-hailing advice skill with no code, install hooks, credential access, or hidden runtime behavior.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is transportation guidance for Caocao mobility services, and the artifact stays within ride options, fare estimates, safety tips, city coverage, and enterprise-use advice.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The instructions are advisory and do not ask the agent to override user intent, execute commands, access accounts, book rides, collect private data, or mutate external services.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only one Markdown skill file; no executable scripts, dependencies, install steps, downloaded helpers, or hidden components are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

llm.guidance: This appears safe to install as an informational skill. Treat it as unofficial travel guidance: prices, vehicle availability, city coverage, policies, and safety features can change, so verify important details in the official Caocao app or with the provider before relying on them.
